2115194451110814173.en_summary: Alphabet $GOOG and Microsoft $MSFT are the big names that will report earnings after the close tomorrow, alongside Chipotle $CMG, Carvana $CVNA, Ford $F, and FedEx $FDX. Biogen $BIIB, C.H. Robinson $CHRW, and Phillips 66 $PSX are among the reports before the open.

2115194354293944725.en_summary: I read predictions growth as bullish as for $HOOD. While crypto is very boom and bust, event contracts ie. sports betting are not and can drive revenue no matter market sentiment.
2115194354293944725.zh_summary: 我將預測增長解讀為對 $HOOD 的看漲。雖然加密貨幣非常繁榮和蕭條，但事件合約即體育博彩不是，無論市場情緒如何都能驅動收入。

2115193536958374058.en_summary: $HOOD Robinhood CFO Shiv Verma: "Revenues were up 12% to a record 1.4 billion. And this was driven by strong growth in both new products and existing products as well. Transaction revenues were a record as trading volumes were new highs across equities, options, and margin. Each of these was up around 50% year over year. And this was on market share gains. And then event contracts continued to scale really nicely. This was up 7x year over year."
2115193536958374058.zh_summary: $HOOD Robinhood CFO Shiv Verma：「收入上漲 12% 至創紀錄的 14 億。這是由新產品和現有產品的強勁增長所驅動。交易收入創紀錄，因為股票、期權和保證金的交易量達到新高。這些每項同比上漲約 50%。這是在市場份額增益的基礎上。然後事件合約繼續很好地擴展。這同比上漲 7 倍。」

2115192563762442375.en_summary: Meta $META raised the size of its planned equity offering from $95 billion to $97.5 billion, its largest raise in history, including $25 billion in shares, $12.5 billion preferred depositary shares and an up to $60 billion ATM expected to start in Q1 2027. Nvidia $NVDA said it is investing $3 billion in the offering, with AMD $AMD investing $1 billion and Broadcom $AVGO also expected to participate.
2115192563762442375.zh_summary: Meta $META 將其計劃的股權發行規模從 950 億美元提高到 975 億美元，這是其歷史上最大的籌資，包括 250 億美元股份、125 億美元優先存託股份和預計於 2027 年第一季度開始的高達 600 億美元 ATM。Nvidia $NVDA 表示將投資 30 億美元於該發行，AMD $AMD 投資 10 億美元，Broadcom $AVGO 也預計參與。
